properties.name: /capture-session asks for the work's rationale, so Copilot's route stops refusing it
properties.rationale: Root-caused in fact:recurrence-capture-session-in-vs-code-is-declined-by-the-models-refusal-stop-not-a-service-failure-2026-10-12: in VS Code with GitHub Copilot (claude-opus-5-5) the old command was refused 5 of 5 times as reasoning_extraction, once in a fresh chat on its first call; with the one phrase changed it completed in fresh chats. The class is served text phrased as a request for the session's "reasoning", which a provider's classifier protects; the lint pins the class, not the one sentence. Would this have prevented 10-09? Yes: the same sentence was in 0.80.0's command. Reaches users at the next release; a user who edited their copy deletes it and runs reflow2 update. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The /capture-session command (getting-started/commands/capture-session.md and its .claude mirror) now asks for "the rationale for the work" where it said "what dies with the session is the reasoning", and the capture-session skill's description says the project's rationale (what was measured, tried and dropped, and why) where it said "the reasoning that exists only in the conversation" (source and .claude/.grok mirrors). tools/skill_lint.py gains asks_for_session_reasoning: a slash command or a skill description that puts "reasoning" beside the session, conversation or chat fails the lint; run against the old text it failed both checks, and nothing else in the tree matched. tools/test_skill_lint.py pins the refused and completed sentences, the old description, the /decisions and /where wording it must not flag, and the real tree (24 tests OK). The MCP-install golden is re-blessed: only .claude/commands/capture-session.md and the kit-version receipt moved; test_init 132 OK. The four skill-findability tests pass on the new description (0.79 s, after a 35m 22s cold build).
